V15-S1.1_pipeline_in_weights_16bit.scope: IQ -> DC block -> 16-tap FIR -> energy/noise/burst, FFT16+CFAR, spectral MLP, CFO, CPU peak search, FM. All on QwenPU's RV32 CPU in weights, Q15/Q2.13. Host copies verified words between stages only.

V15-S1.2_bit_exact.scope: Every token of every neural run equals the RV32(+VX) reference trace, which includes a load of every output. Outputs equal independent integer references. 25 CPU kernels and 4 VX kernels.

V15-S1.3_real_iq_screen.reason: Primary Q15 with unchanged v1.4 preprocessing and criteria: 8/14 (v1.4: 0/14). All 6 failures are input clipping from the inherited gain rule. Pre-declared secondary Q2.13 headroom diagnostic: 13/14; the remaining failure is an argmax near-tie (1.4e-4 relative gap). Criteria not relaxed. Pre-declared Amendment 2 (block-floating-point front end computed on the in-weights CPU: BlockMax + AutoScale): 14/14, 57,344 neural samples, criteria unchanged. Primary result stays 8/14 and is reported alongside.

V15-S1.4_one_checkpoint_runtime_paramete.scope: All kernels are programs on the same unchanged published weights. Taps, windows, tables, thresholds and MLP weights are RAM or WROM data.

V15-S1.5_one_command.scope: v15/scripts/pipeline_run.py prints PASS/FAIL and exits nonzero on failure.

V15-S1.6_actual_published_checkpoint.scope: 14 representative kernels, including both VX kernels, on QwenPU-published chip layers (stock HF Qwen3_5DecoderLayer, SHA-verified shards), free-running and token-exact. Chip-only: Qwen's language layers are not loaded (Stage 2).

V15-S2_qwen_calls_in_weights_rf.scope: Published QwenPU merged checkpoint (SHA-verified). Qwen issues <tool_call> rf_analyze; RF firmware runs on the in-weights RV32 CPU (executor for chip tokens); report echoed as Qwen tokens; 3/3 runs, ~780k computer tokens, every circuit token equal to the RV32 reference. Not a single-GPU full forward: chip layers' role played by the executor; lm_head head-check unavailable.

V15-S2b_full_model_one_gpu.scope: Qwen3.5-4B + plain RV32 CPU merged (19 GB) fully on the 24 GB GPU; chip tokens through saved HF chip layers; 3/3 runs, ~779k chip tokens, 0 lock errors, 0 head mismatches.

V15-S2c_real_data_classifier.scope: IDLab WiFi/LTE/DVB-T, recording-level split: 67.0% window / 70.3% recording accuracy (chance 39.6%); 101 held-out windows run in weights, token-exact, equal to the integer model (69.3% on that subset). Two configurations tried (16 vs 64 frames); both reported.

V15-ARCH_new_VX_RF_instruction_VFIR.scope: New compiled VX instruction (complex Q15 FIR tap block) on QwenPU branch rfpu-vfir: no new layers/heads; oracle, circuit (every token), GPU executor and saved merged checkpoint (5/5 token-exact) verified; 1.8-5.9x faster than scalar on real IQ (4-16 taps). Packed I/O: 2.6/3.5/6.7x (4/8/16 taps). VBFLY not implemented.

V15-ARCH_new_VX_RF_instruction_VPOW.scope: VPOW (custom-2 funct7=1, funct3=1): sum(ar^2+ai^2) mod 2^32 over a VM register. Oracle tests, circuit teacher-forced every token, fused executor free-running 8/8 programs token-exact. 8.8x vs scalar when data is already in VM; ~1x when it must first be loaded from RAM. Not merged into a saved checkpoint.

V15-S3a_timing_study_amendment_3.scope: Pre-declared: VFIR packed 16-tap vs scalar FIR16, 8 independent processes, A-B-B-A. Geometric-mean speedup 6.73x, 95% t-CI [6.727, 6.738], exact sign-flip p=0.0078 (minimum possible with 8 units). Tokens/sample 633.7 vs 94.9.

V15-SPEC_speculative_verification.scope: Exploratory (not pre-declared). Published checkpoint saved chip layers, lowpass16 FIR on 32 real samples (~10k tokens): reference machine drafts the trace, layers verify C tokens per parallel forward. 0 mismatches at C=64/256/1024; 30/60/74x faster than free-running on the same HF layers (35.6 tok/s -> 2,638 tok/s). Audit mode: host also computes the trace. Baseline is the HF path, not the fused executor (~5x faster than HF), and both use reference PyTorch kernels (no flash-linear-attention).

V15-P4_error_budget_precision.scope: Pre-declared Amendment 4, all neural. Block-floating-point FFT64 power: 74.6-76.3 dB arithmetic SQNR at every level -60..0 dBFS (fixed scaling 7.5-66.5 dB), 266 vs 201 tokens/sample. Taylor-interpolated NCO: 85.8 dB (table only 49.0), 72 vs 53 tokens/sample. 34-row error budget across 11 kernels.

V15-P5.1_fft_stage_rewrite.scope: Bit-identical FFT program (no-multiply W0/-j stages, twiddle-outer loops), neural-exact. Tokens/sample: FFT16 151.8->125.1, FFT64 201.3->165.5, FFT64 block 267.9->230.2, FFT256 251.3->205.6, Welch64x4 412.0->342.9 (17-19% fewer); CFAR uses the same subroutine.

V15-P5.2_am_envelope_trim.scope: Magnitude-only CORDIC: 16 iterations bit-identical at 256 tokens/sample (was 450 with angle accumulation); k=10 (fixed by analysis before measurement) 121.6 dB arithmetic SQNR (target >= 90) at 185 tokens/sample: 2.4x fewer tokens.

V15-P5.3_chunked_verification_large.scope: Published checkpoint saved chip layers, FIR64 x 48 real samples, 107,023-token trace: 0 mismatches at every chunk size (256..16384) in every configuration, including flash-linear-attention kernels. Fused executor batch 1: 4,363 tok/s. Chunked, per-position decode: 2.7-3.4k tok/s (torch kernels), 1.5-2.3k (FLA) -- the per-position host sync dominated. Batched decode: 4.4-6.0k (torch), 12.7k (FLA). GPU-side code compare (FLA): 11.5-13.0k tok/s = 3.0x the executor, ~360x the HF free-running path (35.6 tok/s). Mutation test: one altered drafted token (position 50000) is detected (2 mismatches, first at 49999). Audit mode: the host drafts the trace; the model's layers verify every position.

V15-S2d_chunked_verification_in_chat.scope: Qwen calls rf_analyze fully on one GPU (19 GB merge); the computer's tokens are verified C=1024 at a time against the reference lock (ChunkedRvChat, subclass; upstream unmodified). Same firmware, same environment: all 3 questions token-identical to the one-token-at-a-time run (93,449 / 100,884 / 100,984 tokens incl. Qwen's answers); 0 lock errors, 0 head mismatches. Chip time 223-247 s -> 16 s per question (~15x); whole question 255-288 s -> 47-54 s (~5.4x). With flash-linear-attention: chip 11-28 s, Qwen's free-text wording changes (its float layers), every circuit token still exact. Audit mode: the reference drafts, the layers verify.

V15-S2e_rf_levels_compute_only_what_is_a.scope: Second tool rf_levels(capture) on the same firmware (selected from the call text on the CPU): power, peak, noise floor, windows only; skips the CFO accumulation and DFT16. Identical level numbers to rf_analyze, ~28k vs ~93k tokens (3.3x). Both tools offered: Qwen chose rf_levels for 2/2 level questions and rf_analyze for 1/1 frequency question; 27-31 s per level question (was ~270 s), 0 lock errors, 0 head mismatches.

V15-P6.1_vbfly_block_fft.scope: New VX instruction VBFLY (custom-2 funct7=1 funct3=2): constant-geometry radix-2 butterflies, twiddles from a 32-pair RoPE table at i & mask, tracked mode for block floating point (VGET 3 = stage max bit length). 13 layers, 137 heads (+1.4% FFN units). Circuit tests every token; 96 VX regression tests pass. VXFFT64 (CPU window/normalize, 6 VBFLY stages, VPOW bins), neural on the fused executor: 69.5-71.5 dB arithmetic SQNR at every level -60..0 dBFS (target >= 68), 127-133 tokens / 19-21 ms per sample vs the CPU block FFT's 74.6-75.2 dB at 229-233 tokens / 34-38 ms (same circuit): 1.8x faster, ~5 dB less precise.

V15-P6.2_iir_wide.scope: IIRBiquad(wide=True): int32 state/output, no saturation. +12 dB DC-gain filter: 82.3 dB at -12 dBFS and 88.2 dB at -6 dBFS (int16 saturating: 35.1 / 14.8 dB); 130-134 vs 172-176 tokens/sample. Neural-exact.

V15-P6.3_vfir_precision.scope: VFIR 16 taps (per-tap rounding), -12 dBFS: 69.2 dB arithmetic SQNR, below the pre-declared 70 dB target (scalar exact-accumulation FIR16: 81.3 dB). The per-tap rounding contract costs ~12 dB; VFIR is the fast path, kernels.FIR the precise one. Recorded as a failure.

V15-P6.5_energy.scope: Exact scalar energy (16 tokens/sample, exact) is the precision path; VX int8 energy (35 dB, 15 tokens/sample) is a low-precision showcase only.

V15-P6.4_classifier_lag_features.scope: Exploratory, pre-declared method. OFDM cyclic-prefix lag correlations (L = 64, 67, 128, 224, 448) added to the 17 features. Leave-one-location-out CV on the calibration recordings (only 2 locations: merelbeke, rabot) chose baseline+lags (recording accuracy 52% vs 48%). Held-out, evaluated once (host float): 67.2% windows / 70.3% recordings = no improvement over the recorded 70.3%; DVB-T still mostly predicted LTE (399/640). Not implemented in weights. Limitation: training data cover 2 locations, held-out 4; cross-location generalization, not arithmetic, limits accuracy.

V15-P6.4c_classifier_10msps.scope: 26 IDLab recordings at 10 MS/s (LTE 12, WiFi 9, DVB-T 5), same 17 in-weights features, leave-one-recording-out: 84.6% recordings / 70.9% windows (float and the exact integer in-weights model alike), above the 1 MS/s six-location 74.4%. Final model neural on one window per recording: 26/26 token-exact, outputs equal the integer model. Small sample: indicative. DVB-T windows 36/80. First run keyed recordings by file name (two share one): rerun keyed by path; a second run failed out of memory during the concurrent 27 GB merge (ledger).

V15-ARCH_VPOW_VBFLY_saved_checkpoint.scope: Merged checkpoint qwen3.5-4b-vx-rf (Qwen3.5-4B + VX + VFIR + VPOW + VBFLY, branch b72623e), shards SHA-verified, circuit matches metadata. Saved HF chip layers, free-running, every token checked: VXFFT64 one real-IQ frame (8,696 tokens, outputs = independent model), VXFir16 on 16 real samples (2,816), vbfly_program seeds 0/1 (3,744 / 3,962), vpow_program seed 0 (2,075): 5/5 exact.

V15-S2f_real_recordings.scope: Amendment 7: 6 questions on 6 real captures (IDLab WiFi 1 MS/s, LTE 1 and 10 MS/s, DVB-T; EPFL LoRa; Tampere drone 5.8 GHz), both tools offered, fully on one GPU, chunked verification. 6/6: 0 lock errors, 0 head mismatches, every report field equals the host model within firmware tolerances, every asked number quoted exactly in Qwen's answer. Qwen chose rf_levels for the 4 level questions (27.7-28.8k chip tokens) and rf_analyze for spectral/CFO (97-101k); 29-42 s per question.

V15-P8.1_vfir_guard.scope: VFIR guard bit (circuit change, 13 layers; 106 VX tests pass): taps x4, chained rounding constant, rd = sat16(y >> 2). 16 taps at -12 dBFS: 77.9 dB (target >= 75) at 110.5 tokens/sample; per-tap VFIR 69.2 dB at 110.3 (P6.3, still recorded as failed); exact scalar FIR16 81.3 dB at 624.8.

V15-P8.6_vbfly_fixed_vs_block.scope: Ablation, neural: VXFFT64 untracked fixed scaling 6.6-64.1 dB over -60..0 dBFS at 103 tokens/sample (-12 dBFS) vs tracked block floating point 69.5-71.5 dB at 129 tokens/sample.

V15-P8.3a_regress_real_iq_bfp.scope: Rerun on today's code: 14/14, 57,344 neural samples (same as 2026-11-03).

V15-P8.2_classifier_bandwidth.scope: 10 MS/s IDLab (26 recordings), 17 features + 64 occupied-bandwidth features (FFT64 power shape), leave-one-recording-out: 96.2% recordings / 78.8% windows for the exact integer in-weights model (was 84.6% / 70.9%); DVB-T windows 62/80 (was 36/80). Final model, two stages in weights per window (FFT64 power, host copy of verified words, 81-feature classifier): 26/26 token-exact, outputs equal references, predictions equal the integer model. Small sample (5 DVB-T recordings): indicative.

V15-P8.4_regress_stage2_robust.scope: Robust suite, full GPU, chunked: 0 lock errors, 0 head mismatches; same decisions as the recorded run (no tool for index 20 and the no-tool question; firmware error reported for -1; 2.2 dB comparison); repeated question token-identical. No label leak in the answer (the 2026-11-03 run had one).

Seconds per question 277.8 / 110.3 / 58.1 / 47.6 / 46.1 (chip 227.8 / 68.3 / 25.8 / 17.3 / 16.1).
